assertions.description: The clock_source_4chan design uses a 5PB1104PGxx clock buffer IC (IDT, nominal 50-ohm input/output) to distribute a TCXO signal to four outputs via 50-ohm UMC coaxial connectors. The schematic notes explicitly state '5PB1104 is nominal 50 Ohm input/output impedance'. The rf_chains and rf_matching arrays are empty. A clock buffer with 50-ohm coaxial outputs is effectively an RF distribution chain and should be detected as such, or at minimum as a clock distribution network.
